fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-4dda77b1 at 4d79c2be read the diff: build.toml (builder, verifier) and review.toml (5 checks, critic, fixer, verifier) prompts each append 'Run only the tests covering what your change touches, never the repo's full suite: the PR's CI runs it before merge.' and name no go test, make check, make test or testscript. New TestBuiltinRolePromptsScopeTests in internal/workflow parses both built-ins via Builtin/Parse, collects every builder/verifier/critic/fixer/check prompt, and asserts the rule is present and none of the four commands appear. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/workflow: ok (test PASS under -v). No cmd/rhiza testscript golden prints these prompts (grep for their text finds none); as a smoke check go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(build-evidence-commit|run-ship-signoff|review-signoff-changes|inbox-signoff|autonomous-review|run-ship-change|guide-install|describe-golden)$': ok. The commit's only .rhiza/log files are the builder's own actor record.
